about.en: POR is the official fan token of the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF) and the Portugal national football team. It is issued by Socios.com (Chiliz) as a CAP-20 token on Chiliz Chain at 0x013F2407c6eF765F1199f8818B805121F269F5b8 and gives holders voting rights in team polls, rewards and fan-engagement features; it carries no ownership of the federation. It is unrelated to Portuma (POR).
